snippet.title: Lost & Found – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4466940/Lost__Found/

Lost & Found is an adventure-mystery game where you return townsfolk’s lost belongings & uncover personal stories behind each item. It features a hybrid animation style that blends 2D, 3D, pixel art, & more. Gather clues, investigate locals, & ensure every lost belonging ends up in the right hands. 

--- 

Join the game’s Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5DGvtNQDTh 

Get the game’s Free Concept Art Book: https://shaggybeargames.carrd.co/
